basis: Microcephaly, endocrine dysfunction and skeletal growth abnormalities define syndrome; cardiomyopathy in 1/2 reported patients; individual renal anomalies each 1/5.
Cancer susceptibility without intrinsic organ damage; associated cancers are separate diagnoses and do not establish organ involvement.
Defined by electrolyte and fluid shifts during refeeding; cardiac and other organ failures are not universal defining features.
Lysosomal storage disorder defined by progressive neurodegeneration; retinal degeneration is variable and generally absent in classic adult Kufs disease.
Thymic gland disorder with an explicit endocrine-system parent; immunodeficiency, autoimmunity and blood-cell disease are not intrinsic across this umbrella.
Spondylometaphyseal skeletal dysplasia; no evidence of common damage to another organ axis.
Disordered vertebral and epiphyseal development with skeletal deformities and progressive joint degeneration.
Intellectual disability, microcephaly, epilepsy and skeletal dysplasia define syndrome; hirsutism alone does not establish skin damage.
Congenital retinal malformations and blindness accompany defining neurodevelopmental impairment; deafness, immunodeficiency and hypogonadism are variable.
Carcinoma originates in the subglottic larynx, within the airway axis.
Neurodevelopmental disorder; nail hypoplasia 80-99% and hypohidrosis 30-79%; strabismus/ptosis 30-79%. Reflux is separately diagnosed; skeletal traits lack clear damage.
Mature teratoma originates in the CNS pineal region; endocrine gland dysfunction is not established.
Acrofacial skeletal dysostosis with obligate intellectual disability; damaging ocular findings and hearing impairment are each only occasional.
ADHD is a neurodevelopmental disorder, explicitly covered by the neurologic axis.
Primary immunodeficiency; ectodermal dysplasia affects most (~70-80%), commonly impairing sweating and tooth development. Osteopetrosis is subtype-specific.
Sarcoma arises in deep soft connective tissues, commonly pelvic or perineal; regional genital involvement does not imply endocrine dysfunction.
Defined by structural or functional disease of the cerebellum.
NAD(P)HX repair deficiency causes metabolic encephalopathy and myelopathy; frequent respiratory failure reflects neurologic dysfunction rather than direct lung disease.
Sterol biosynthesis disorder with neurologic defects; cataracts and aortic stenosis each 30-79%. Pigment changes and renal ectopia alone do not establish functional damage.
Chronic Corynebacterium infection directly affects intertriginous skin.
Peripheral neuropathy and congenital digital extensor muscle/tendon aplasia define disease; reduced sweating reflects autonomic neuropathy rather than intrinsic skin injury.
Familial adrenal androgen hypersecretion is an endocrine functional disorder.
Syndromic intellectual disability with microcephaly and spasticity; stature and facial traits do not establish skeletal damage; small testes do not establish hormone deficiency.
Hereditary prostate cancer concerns a reproductive organ outside the axes; AR association alone does not establish endocrine disease.
Acneiform inflammatory lesions directly affect skin; infection and medication exposure are possible causes rather than universal disease mechanisms.
